svg.title: ArcGIS Web MCP – Architecture
svg.desc: MCP clients connect over HTTPS and OAuth 2.1 to the ArcGIS Web MCP server on Cloudflare Workers, which signs each user in with ArcGIS and calls ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Enterprise with that user's own permissions.
svg.metadata: Icons: ArcGIS product logos and Calcite UI icons (Esri); client logos from Lobe Icons (MIT). Product names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners.
svg.text: Connect AI assistants to ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise — every call runs with your own ArcGIS permissions.
